subject: [PATCH 11/16] selftests/mm: race-harness variant for permissive hole occupancy

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new variant to the selftests/mm/khugepaged_race test, which exercises permissive hole occupancy by selecting hole-heavy windows and allowing racing faults to fill in holes. The test is run with max_ptes_none=0 by default, but can be changed to use the permissive limit with the -z option. This allows for testing of collapsing a window that contains holes, where a racing fault may have filled in the hole before it's re-checked under the page table lock at install time.
